# so the order is 3 x 10 x 27 = 810. A base dart i -> j carrying a voltage a in Z_10 and an affine
# map (M, u) over F_3^3 joins (i, z, x) to (j, z + a mod 10, M x + u). The six darts with their
# voltages and matrices are listed in the accompanying json; the graph is 12-regular of diameter
